summary: A command that reads the Cloudflare account needs `CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN` and `CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID`, and one or both are not set, so it stopped before reading anything. With `--format json`, `bynk revert` writes `{"error": {"code", "missing", "message"}}` to stdout, `missing` naming each variable that is unset; the message says what the token needs.
